newsitem.title: USA: Ohio unemployment rate remains at 4.2 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Ohio unemployment rate remains at 4.2 pct in July.

text.p: Ohio's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate remained at 4.2 percent in July from June and down six-tenths of a percentage point from one year ago, the employment services bureau reported Friday.

July marked continuing growth in the service sector with declines in manufacturing primarily from temporary annual layoffs in the automobile industry for retooling, bureau Administrator Debra Bowland said.
Nonfarm wage and salary employment declined by 2,000 jobs in July to 5.352 million with goods producers down 13,000 positions and service producers up 11,000, the bureau reported.
